chunks: And by this chain, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAmmār ibn Marwān, from Munakhkhal, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh (عليه السلام), who said:
Jibrāʾīl (عليه السلام) descended upon Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) with this verse like this:
O you who were given the Book, believe in what We have sent down concerning ʿAlī, a clear light.

key_terms.آمِنُوا: believe; a command to affirm faith
key_terms.أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ: those who were given the Book, i.e. the People of the Book
key_terms.الْآيَةِ: the verse being cited in this narration
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrāʾīl, the angel who conveys revelation
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ʿAlī, identified here as the subject of the revealed statement
key_terms.نُورًا مُبِينًا: a clear light; an expression of manifest illumination

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret the verse addressing the People of the Book in relation to Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a reported revealed wording connected to a Qur'anic verse, stating that Jibrāʾīl (عليه السلام) brought it concerning Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام). In context, it highlights the theme of wilayah and the luminous, manifest status associated with ʿAlī (عليه السلام) in Shia hadith literature.

en.hubeali:
And by this chain, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Munakhhal, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Jibraeelas descended unto Muhammadsaww with this Verse like this [4:47]
O you who have been Given the Book! Believe that which We have Revealed regarding Aliasws as a clear Light’.
en.sarwar: 27. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Munakhkhal from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Jibril brought the following verse to Prophet Muhammad (s.a).
“People of the Book, have faith in the what We have revealed (about Ali’s Leadership with Divine Authority). .” [4:47]
